description: Adversarial minimal pairs for the semantic publication gate. Synthetic and generic: no claim, quote or subject is taken from the development calibration cases, so a result here is independent of that set. This is a regression suite, not a benchmark -- it says the gate still refuses the transformations it was built to refuse, and says nothing about general entailment accuracy.
